statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness

The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
The symptoms must be correlated with cardiac rhythm disturbances
CPT code 93247 (long-term continuous ECG monitoring study) was billed
The diagnosis code R42 was submitted
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
